title: One Time CRM frontend performance and scoped selection flow

reasons: The source statement specifically names CRM frontend performance and root rerender behavior.
Audit evidence shows CRM routes can remain loading and the existing loader needs a scoped proof harness.
The work is app-visible but narrow enough for a focused implementation packet.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Production deploy/live smoke remains blocked from Done until REQ-20260712-112 release lane.
recommended_packet_sequence: run local split-shell and monolith smokes
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Implement REQ-20260712-106 only; do not redesign the whole CRM/inbox.

operator_intent_summary: Remove the CRM root rerender and global data-loader side effects so One Time CRM list/search/detail interactions stay scoped, paginated, cancelable, and measurable.
raw_quotes: CRM frontend must avoid the giant global data loader/root rerender on contact selection, use AbortController, debounced search, cached detail, scoped refresh, hidden legacy table avoidance, and retire duplicate legacy renderer after parity.
Contact selection does not call the application-wide render function.
Initial CRM API calls after auth are no more than 3.
Initial rows rendered are no more than 50.
Stale requests are aborted and search is debounced.
Legacy CRM review table is not constructed while closed.

decisions_captured.decision: Required source screenshots are unavailable locally.

out_of_scope: No broad CRM/inbox redesign in this packet; that remains REQ-20260712-107.
No email, WhatsApp, payment, access grant, DNS, provider-account, external CRM, or production-data writes.
No deploy/live-smoke Done claim; release proof remains REQ-20260712-112.
No fixing unrelated VQ findings outside CRM loader/performance behavior.
affected_surfaces: One Time CRM review/source safeguards details panel

inspected: public/operations.html CRM functions call render() on list load and contact selection.
public/js/operations-shell.js is the actual /operations split shell and has older CRM workbench behavior.
Local smoke served operations.html directly and needs to cover operations-bootstrap.html as well.
Legacy One Time CRM review/source safeguards table is built even when its details element is closed.
known_gaps: Contact selection currently triggers application-wide render().
Search filter reloads immediately and is not debounced.
CRM fetches do not use AbortController.
Initial list does not enforce a frontend 50-card render cap.
Split shell and monolith CRM behavior are not in parity.

expanded_phrases.CRM: For this packet, CRM means the first-party One Time Operations contact list/search/filter/selected detail/timeline flow only; it excludes broad inbox redesign and all external CRM runtimes.
expanded_phrases.working: Working means measured local behavior: no root render on selection, <=3 CRM API calls after auth, <=50 initial cards, abortable stale requests, debounced search, and smoke evidence.
expanded_phrases.professional: Professional means the loader behaves predictably, preserves context, avoids jank, and keeps no-send/read-only states explicit.
expanded_phrases.clean: Clean means legacy review/source safeguards stay collapsed without constructing hidden table DOM until opened.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use first-party BNA CRM records and local timeline readbacks only; no GHL, LeadConnector, or external CRM writes.

implementation_batches.scope: Operations One Time first-party CRM loader/detail only
instructions: Patch API request helper to accept AbortController signals.
Patch list/detail rendering to update only the CRM panel instead of calling render() from selection.
Add search debounce, normalized query cache, frontend 50-card cap, and stale request aborts.
Render legacy review/source safeguards table only after details are opened.
Extend smoke harness to cover split shell and monolith fallback with request/card assertions.
